visual_review: Before: glasses without temple arms fused into an 'oo' and a bare U-shaped book with no pages, which read as a magnet. After: two r6 lenses with a raised bridge arc and temple stubs, and a side-view closed book with a flat rounded-corner spine, top and bottom covers and a page line; reads as reading glasses over a book at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Reference's second page line omitted (the 16-unit book height fits one page line at 8 spacing).
